findings: Every held-out forecast was generated before that match and the model was then updated, preventing future results from leaking backward.
The model estimates team attack, defense, and home advantage, then converts expected goals into score and win/draw/loss probabilities with a Poisson distribution.
A full-season Leicester City vs Arsenal example produces 44.213% home, 26.508% draw, and 29.279% away, with 1–1 the most likely score.
This is an educational baseline, not betting advice: injuries, lineups, odds, and uncertainty beyond historical scores are not modeled.
